product.name: Monoprice 6in SATA 15-pin Female to Molex 4-pin Male Power Adapter
product.description: Got a new SATA drive that you need to connect to a system with an older power supply?  Here's a solution.This is an adapter is for connecting internal storage devices that require 15 pin SATA power connectors to Power supplies that only have 4 pin molex  power connectors.  i.e. YOUR DRIVE IS A NEWER SATA, BUT YOUR COMPUTER IS AN OLDER ONE WITH MOLEX. Warning:  Molex connector provide 12V and 5V power lines, but not 3.3V required by some SATA drives.  Make sure your drive does not require a 3.3V power connection before purchasing this adapter.
